summary: Iteration 5 — verified all four newly-wired surfaces: brand logos in nav + footer, About /brand entry, Kids Coloring Studio gallery, and Bookstore refund-notice. Backend (6/6 pytest) + frontend (5/5 Playwright) all green. Buy-access intentionally disabled (mocked LemonSqueezy) — not flagged as a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: About.jsx: relies on first /brand entry; if SEED_BRAND ever grows to >1 it could pick the wrong one. Consider filtering by slug 'about-the-author' explicitly.
KidsColoringStudio.jsx: COLORING_PAGES is hard-coded (only 1 page). Once /kids/coloring/*.md is in GitHub, switch to API fetch — the comment already documents this intent.
Bookstore refund notice link uses Link to '/legal#refund-policy' which works for SPA navigation but won't auto-scroll to the anchor on its own — consider scroll-into-view on hash change.
Bookstore card slug pattern (e.g. 'genesis-protocols-volume-i-book') makes the data-testid long; review request mentioned 'genesis-protocol' as a sample — no functional issue, just naming drift.
test_credentials: n/a — auth not exercised this iteration; /api/auth/me confirmed 401 unauthenticated.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded brand/books/legal entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four iteration-5 deliverables verified. Backend GET /api/content/entries?surface=brand returns exactly 1 entry (slug=about-the-author, title='A blank page, and the programs we carry') with the preface text. /api/books returns 4 books with slugs starting with meditation-pack, star-whispers, genesis-protocols. /api/content/entries?surface=legal returns 4 entries including refund-policy. Static assets /assets/brand/prulesoul-logo.png and /assets/kids/coloring/aurin-kids-cover.png both 200 with naturalWidth=1363. Frontend: brand-logo + brand-logo-image + footer-brand + footer-brand-logo all visible & loaded; About renders about-entry with 'This book is part of my life story.' and 'A market in Egypt'; Kids Coloring grid contains kids-coloring-card-aurin-kids-cover, age 3-5 filter retains card, age 9-12 shows kids-coloring-empty, download href ends in .png, back button navigates to /kids-universe; Bookstore renders refund notice for all 4 books with /legal#refund-policy link and disabled Buy-access buttons; mobile nav toggle works.
